forwarders.description: List of upstream DNS server IPs for recursive resolution.

dns_port.description: Port number on which BIND listens for DNS queries.

listen_on.description: IPv4 addresses/interfaces to listen on for DNS queries.

listen_on_v6.description: IPv6 addresses/interfaces to listen on for DNS queries.

allow_query.description: ACL of clients permitted to send DNS queries.

allow_transfer.description: ACL of secondary servers permitted to transfer zone data (AXFR/IXFR). Leave empty to disable transfers.

recursion_enabled.description: Enable recursive queries for authorized clients.

ratelimit_enabled.description: Enable rate limiting for responses to mitigate DNS amplification attacks.

ratelimit_rps.description: Maximum responses per second per client under rate limiting.

ratelimit_window.description: Time window (in seconds) for rate limiting calculation.

edns_enabled.description: Enable EDNS (Extension Mechanisms for DNS) support.

working_dir.description: Working directory for temporary files and zone dump files.

pid_file.description: Path to the BIND process PID file.
